test_cases.scenario: Add an in-stock product to an empty cart
preconditions: Shopper is logged in with an empty cart
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Toast 'Added to cart' is shown, the cart icon count changes from 0 to 1, and the cart contains one 'Blue Mug' line with quantity 1

test_cases.scenario: Adding a product already in the cart increments the existing line
preconditions: Cart contains one 'Blue Mug' line with quantity 1
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: The cart still has exactly one 'Blue Mug' line, now with quantity 2; no second line is created

test_cases.scenario: Add the maximum selectable quantity of 10
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Toast 'Added to cart' is shown and the cart contains 'Blue Mug' with quantity 10

steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Quantity 0 cannot be selected or the add is rejected; the cart stays empty and no 'Added to cart' toast appears

steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Quantity 11 cannot be selected or the add is rejected; the cart stays empty and no 'Added to cart' toast appears

test_cases.scenario: Non-whole or empty quantity cannot be added
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
For each value in `quantities`, try to enter it in the quantity field and click 'Add to cart'
test_cases.expected_result: None of the values can be added; the cart stays empty after every attempt
test_cases.notes: If the quantity control is a dropdown/stepper that cannot accept these values, record that as the pass evidence.

test_cases.scenario: Adding to a line already at 10 shows the maximum message
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'You can buy a maximum of 10 units of this item' is shown and the 'Blue Mug' line quantity remains 10

test_cases.scenario: Adding to a line at 9 reaches the maximum of 10
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Toast 'Added to cart' is shown and the line quantity becomes 10 with no maximum message

test_cases.scenario: Add that would push a line from 8 to 11 is rejected
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'You can buy a maximum of 10 units of this item' is shown and the line quantity stays 8

test_cases.scenario: Requesting more than available stock is rejected
steps: Open the 'Red Lamp' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Only 3 left in stock' is shown, nothing is added, and the cart icon count stays 0

test_cases.scenario: Requesting exactly the available stock is allowed
steps: Open the 'Red Lamp' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Toast 'Added to cart' is shown, no stock message appears, and the cart has 'Red Lamp' with quantity 3

test_cases.scenario: Guest adds a product to a guest cart
preconditions: Shopper is not logged in and has an empty cart
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product detail page as a guest
test_cases.expected_result: Toast 'Added to cart' is shown and the guest cart contains 'Blue Mug' with quantity 1, without being asked to log in

test_cases.scenario: Guest cart is merged into the account cart on login
preconditions: Account asha@example.com has 'Red Lamp' x1 in its cart
Shopper is a guest with 'Blue Mug' x2 in the guest cart
steps: As the guest, log in as asha@example.com
test_cases.expected_result: Cart contains 'Red Lamp' x1 and 'Blue Mug' x2; no guest item is lost

test_cases.scenario: Adding a second different product increments the cart count by 1
preconditions: Cart contains 'Blue Mug' x1 and the cart icon shows 1
steps: Open the 'Red Lamp' product detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Toast 'Added to cart' is shown, the cart icon count changes from 1 to 2, and the cart has two separate lines

gaps.description: Merging when guest and account carts contain the same product (sum vs cap at 10)
Whether the cart icon counts units or lines after a quantity increase
Adding a product with stock 0 and stock checks that include quantity already in the cart
gaps.reason: AC-CART-1 and AC-CART-5 do not define these cases

coverage_summary.notes: All six acceptance criteria are covered, with boundaries on the 1-10 quantity range, the 10-unit line cap and available stock. Rejection of invalid quantities (TC-CART-004..006) and the over-cap add (TC-CART-009) rely on assumptions A-2 and A-1. The biggest open risk is the guest-cart merge conflict rule (Q-3).

requirements.text: A shopper can add a product to the cart from the product detail page

acceptance_criteria.text: Adding an in-stock product adds it with quantity 1, increments the cart icon count by 1 and shows toast 'Added to cart'
Adding a product already in the cart increases the existing line's quantity by 1 instead of creating a new line
Selected quantity must be a whole number between 1 and 10 inclusive
Adding to a line with quantity 10 shows 'You can buy a maximum of 10 units of this item' and the quantity stays 10
Requesting more than the available stock shows 'Only <n> left in stock' and nothing is added
A guest's items are stored in a guest cart and merged into the account cart on login

business_rules.text: An add that would take a cart line above 10 units is rejected with the maximum message and the line keeps its quantity
